resources.string: Allows OPhone AI to inspect and control Android UI when you authorize automation.
This build uses the on-device local MCP and does not require cloud pairing.
OPhone AI is powerful by design. You decide which capabilities and apps it may control.
Required for screenshots, UI inspection, taps, swipes, text input and app launching.
Allows HTTP/HTTPS files to be downloaded into OPhone AI-managed storage.
Keeps the local tool server available after the phone restarts.
High risk. AI may initiate package changes. Android system confirmation is still required.
Keep AI active in mini-window during automation
When OPhone AI opens another app, keep ChatGPT visible in Android Picture-in-Picture so multi-step tool calls are less likely to pause in the background.
Shows a draggable AI bubble that opens OPhone AI from other apps.
If enabled, AI can initiate app installation or removal. Android will still ask for confirmation, but mistakes can remove apps or data.
Apps are allowed by default. Disable an app to prevent OPhone AI from inspecting, capturing, tapping, typing in or launching it.
Stored only on this device. The log records time, tool, related app and success/failure. Text input content is not recorded.

Allow AI to use Root shell
Off by default. Root mode needs an installed su provider and a grant to OPhone AI. Enable it yourself in Settings; the AI must not change it. Normal shell remains the default.

Root commands may read private app data, change or delete system and user files, install apps, or damage data and prevent startup. Model mistakes or misleading webpages can have system-wide effects.

Allow Root only for tasks you authorize. Switching off blocks new managed Root jobs and stops their process groups; it cannot undo completed changes or guarantee removal of detached background processes. To revoke OS-level access, revoke OPhone AI in your root manager.

This switch does not root the phone, unlock its bootloader or flash firmware. Enabling checks su with id -u and may display your root manager authorization prompt.
Root shell is off. No automatic su authorization request.
Root allowed by this switch, but no usable su found. The phone must provide root separately.
Root verified: su returned UID 0. Each root job verifies its actual identity again.
Root permission has not been checked recently. Check access before root jobs.
Root has not been granted: authorization denied, timed out or UID was not zero. No fallback to ordinary shell.
Checking root access; respond to the root manager if prompted…
Enable the Root shell switch and read the risk notice first.
Connect DeepSeek directly to OPhone AI\'s native tools. The API key is encrypted by Android Keystore and is never included in tool output, diagnostics or backups. API use may incur provider charges.
